task_description: Multiply corresponding elements of two tiny tensors.
correct_kernel:
import nki
import nki.language as nl
import nki.isa as nisa

@nki.jit
def kernel(a,b):
    tile=nl.ndarray((2,3),a.dtype,buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile,src=a)
    other=nl.ndarray((2,3),b.dtype,buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=other,src=b)
    nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=tile,data1=tile,data2=other,op=nl.multiply)
    out=nl.ndarray((2,3),a.dtype,buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out,src=tile)
    return out
